market_bullets: Coverage: 10/10 same-day notes. Today calls: 1 constructive and 9 defensive. Original asynchronous premarket snapshots are retained, not refreshed live quotes.

Completed October 28 velocity is positive in 9/10 names, yet today’s red semiconductor indications override mechanical continuation. NVDA is the negative-VEL5 exception; a repaired oscillator is not a live gap reversal.

SIMO alone carries a constructive Today call: official Q3 operating delivery and Q4 outlook support its earnings gap. Negative Q3 operating cash flow and FCF prevent treating accounting growth as self-funded growth.

Samsung memory strength supports the operating cycle, while MU’s red indication shows business strength and stock-path weakness can coexist. Device affordability and funding costs remain counterweights.

Microsoft and Alphabet show strong cloud monetization, but funding and architecture differ. Alphabet’s negative quarter FCF and TPU system sales are not NVIDIA/AMD orders; Meta investment intentions are not verified settlement or issuer cash receipt.

Intel reports after today’s close; that release is outside Today’s closing endpoint. AMD November 3, ARM/Qualcomm November 4, NET November 5 and NVIDIA November 17 are the notes’ next operating gates.

NET’s lost RSI-50 level and sharp velocity deceleration reinforce a defensive call; DDoS attack counts and private-browser features do not prove paid adoption, stronger margins or resolved trust risk.

Repeated monthly direction misses persist despite wide bands; do not call range containment alpha. Confidence is subjective, ranges are terminal-close scenarios, and Mytutopia strategy gates are delayed app state—not trade instructions.
